title: Youth group calls shutdown in three Arunachal districts over arrests
seoTitle: Itanagar shutdown call over dam arrests

tea.why: Protesters oppose the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, forced surveys, and the deployment of central security forces.
tea.want: The release of arrested agitators and the halt of surveys for the hydropower project.
tea.changed: Nov 1: The SUMP Affected Area Youth Association announced a district shutdown for November 2.

summary: The SUMP Affected Area Youth Association has called for a shutdown across the Siang, Upper Siang, and East Siang districts of Arunachal Pradesh to protest the arrests of individuals participating in the movement against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. According to the organisation, the shutdown is planned for November 2 and was resolved during an emergency executive meeting on October 29. The association stated that the arrests and the deployment of Central Armed Police Forces for pre-feasibility surveys are attempts to suppress legitimate opposition from indigenous communities. The hydropower project has drawn sustained resistance due to concerns over the submergence of villages, displacement, loss of land, and the preservation of the Adi community's traditional way of life. The association has urged other local groups, including the Bogum Bokang Welfare Society and the Siang Indigenous Farmer Forum, to support the peaceful and democratic demonstration.
demands: Stop forced surveys for the Siang project
Withdraw central armed police forces from project areas
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The SUMP Affected Area Youth Association held an emergency executive meeting with village representatives to resolve on a district shutdown.
The youth association announced a shutdown across Siang, Upper Siang, and East Siang districts for November 2.
